changelog: Auto-updater v1.1.16 upgrade fix, loop breaker, and OAuth resilience

changes: Seamless auto-updates from v1.1.16 without download or contract errors
Updater infinite retry loop breaker with automatic manual fallback notice
Fixed Google and Discord sign-in on fresh Windows and debloated PC setups
Added device binding reset guidance on device transfer conflicts
Automatic CMOS clock drift compensation during authentication
Public update channel temporarily reverted to v1.1.16 while the newer release defects are investigated.
Protected updates now explain incompatible payloads and open the official Setup recovery route.
Temporary backend failures now preserve a valid session and retry on a bounded schedule.
Definitive invalid or device-mismatched sessions still fail closed and use the normal sign-in flow.
Startup Manager now respects its pin and game-launch trigger and gives clearer setup guidance.
Game Mode activation summaries finish faster while retaining the complete activation log.
CPU and GPU tuning gains supported hardware controls, saved profiles, and AMD fan-curve support.
Cloud Config Sync, dashboard analytics, checkout ownership, and currency surfaces are more consistent.
Offline mode, navigation, sign-in layout, and website mobile feedback paths were repaired.
Version 1.1.15 was skipped - everything from it is included here.
Fixed the update loop: an update now installs and stays installed, instead of downloading, restarting, and coming back on the old version.
An update that fails repeatedly now stops retrying and offers the manual installer instead of looping, and update failures record which step failed.
Quickstart now shows 4 steps and scrolls for the rest, instead of taking over the whole Home page.
Quickstart opens on the step you are actually on - finish steps 1 and 2 and it opens on step 3, instead of making you scroll past completed items.
Removed the Quickstart collapse arrow, and fixed the checklist not scrolling so steps 5-10 are reachable.
Quickstart step descriptions now wrap instead of being cut off mid-sentence.
The Quickstart GPU step now names both NVIDIA and AMD when your PC has both, instead of always reading as NVIDIA-only.
The first-run welcome/tutorial video is now a real onboarding step, shown once per install instead of being reachable only from the Home card.
Removed the Audio & Latency Tuner; its one genuinely useful control, Disable Audio Enhancements, moved into General Tweaks.
Fixed Startup Manager repeating "Activating..." forever on Roblox and Fortnite, caused by anti-cheat tightening process access mid-session.
Startup Manager game launch profiles can now apply Game Mode directly.
Fixed the Priority Tuner overlay replaying its activation animation several times during one game session.
Fixed "Custom CPU apply failed unexpectedly" in CPU Overclocking on real shipped builds.
Fixed the update loop: an update now installs and stays installed, instead of downloading, restarting, and coming back on the old version.
An update that fails repeatedly now stops retrying and offers the manual installer instead of looping, and update failures record which step failed.
Quickstart now shows 4 steps and scrolls for the rest, scrolling to your current step automatically, and step descriptions wrap instead of being cut off.
The Quickstart GPU step now names both NVIDIA and AMD when your PC has both, instead of always reading as NVIDIA-only.

Fixed the Priority Tuner overlay replaying its activation animation several times during one game session.
Fixed "Custom CPU apply failed unexpectedly" in CPU Overclocking on real shipped builds.
Fixed AMD CPU Tuner applies on CPPC-active systems by excluding only the unreadable legacy P-state request, so Ultra and Boost profiles can complete their remaining verified rows.
Auto-detected games now activate the full Game Mode session, and the Startup Manager Game Mode switch takes effect on the next detection.
Expanded Quickstart to 10 guided steps, added the official AMD driver installer, and replaced the continuous checklist glow with a static highlight.
Standalone CPU, Priority, Network, and Overclocking ownership now appears correctly in the sidebar, Settings, and Add-ons dialog.
Fixed the sign-in email-panel layout, protected native-island single-file validation, backend reliability/index rollout, and website cache/mobile fixes.
Admin sessions now last 30 days with Error Logs and Rank Award Logs.
Fixes an update loop where 1.0.11 and 1.0.12 could re-download the same version without installing it
Updates now retry a locked install folder instead of failing, and recover automatically from an interrupted update
Diagnostics are now encrypted and stored in the app folder instead of your Desktop
Bug reports can attach the encrypted diagnostic log so support can see what went wrong
Diagnostic logging is now opt-in - set XNRL_DEBUGLOG=1 to capture a support trace
Faster entitlement checks and reduced backend load
Reward notifications now resolve from a cached index
Fixed the legacy 1.0.6 update loop with a protected one-time Setup migration path and verified installed 1.0.8 health acknowledgement.
Hardened single-file installer startup and applied Poppins typography without weakening wpf-max protection.
Separated shared-IP and per-account Google and Discord authentication limits so legitimate accounts do not consume one another.
Deployed and smoke-tested the guarded authentication backend with all security tests passing.
Fixed the CPU security-control self-test contract and retained bounded protected resource checks.
Added single-publisher locking, immutable-release enforcement, consumed-version history checks, and manifest convergence retries.
Rebuilt and verified the exact 1.0.11 protected app, installer, navigation, authentication, native-island, and tamper gates.
Fixed the protected auto-update handoff so the helper validates and consumes its one-use ticket before the old process exits.
Fixed umbrella apply-on-startup reconciliation for all wired feature paths, including CPU/GPU overclock startup state.
Apex purchases now seed all four 30-day add-on trials without overwriting existing trial clocks.
Repaired Discord server-booster verification and clarified sign-in/boost requirements.
Fixed the Google sign-in icon, onboarding Continue flow, game-mode minimize behavior, and clipped UI surfaces.
Preserved Wallpaper Library WPF binding contracts through wpf-max so artwork, ratings, and card controls survive protection.
Added server-owned referral rewards: 1 referral earns 14 days of Apex and 5 referrals earn 60 days, with idempotent qualification.
Added duplicate-safe affiliate attribution and tiered 30/35/40 percent commission accounting for eligible purchases.
Expanded protected navigation, startup, backend, localization, and release-contract validation.
Completely reworked the CPU Tuner with per-architecture profile staging, hardware-gated controls, and graceful handling of unsupported configurations.
Added the new Game Compressor feature to reduce game storage footprint without impacting load times or in-game performance.
Expanded next-generation CPU support including Intel Series 2 Core Ultra and AMD Zen 5 with advanced power, cache, and prefetch policy controls.
Added Windows 11 24H2 latency-hint EPP support for autonomous system responsiveness tuning.
Expanded Intel platform power and ring frequency controls across supported Xeon and desktop families.
Resolved Apex State tracking and startup persistence issues; improved profile scaling and Apex Game Mode reliability.
Separated CPU Overclocking SMU hold loops from transactional MSR operations for safer concurrent execution.
Fixed add-on listing, gift-code generation, and referral tracking visibility in Rewards & Refer & Earn.
Fixed GPU Overclocking startup reapply logic for standalone GPU Overclocking owners.
Hardened hardware transaction gates, DPAPI recovery journaling, WHEA error guards, and atomic fail-closed rollback.
Keep Safe notifications now default to opt-in for a less intrusive out-of-box experience.
Polished toast notification feedback, preserved BAML binding contracts across UI carousels, and improved overall UI responsiveness.
Expanded localization coverage across all 9 supported languages.
